data.title: A2 · 避难所的雨
data.description: 夜雨落在避难所窗外。A2 穿着宽松衬衫倚坐窗台，膝上搭着毯子，望着被雨洗净的街道。
data.action: 倚坐在废弃工厂避难所破损窗框边缘，冷峻注视着酸雨流淌成河
data.lighting: 窗外冷光与室内微弱灯光
data.promptProse: Wrapped in a heavy, threadbare military blanket inside the shattered concrete frame of an abandoned skyscraper window, A2 stares silently out at torrential rain drumming over the overgrown City Ruins below. Gray storm clouds hang low over crumbling highway overpasses and giant rusted machine husks, with cool mist dampening her pale face and silent, unyielding gaze.
data.animaCaption: A blanket lies across her knees.
